SAM.name: Samurai Army
SAM.weakness: Less effective when scattered or attacked from multiple directions.

SHI.name: Shinobi Army
SHI.weakness: Lower sustained DEF and reduced power in prolonged frontal engagements.

KNI.name: Knight Army
KNI.weakness: Lower mobility without cavalry; vulnerable to being surrounded.

DRG.name: Dragon Host
DRG.weakness: Anti-air zones, enclosed maps, ritual bindings, limited objective capture.

RIT.name: Ritual Cult
RIT.weakness: Specialist teams only; cannot unlock extra commanders or elites.

THC.name: Thorn Coven
THC.identity: Attrition, entanglement and the patient garden
THC.weakness: Slow to reposition; loses its terrain advantage on open, burned or flooded ground.

ANG.name: Angelic Host
ANG.identity: Airborne judgement in a fixed hierarchy
ANG.weakness: Every unit flies, so anti-air ground and binding rituals hit the whole army at once. Archangels are one copy each.

STM.name: Stormbound Clan
STM.identity: A bloodline of warriors and stormcallers
STM.weakness: Its own chains and rods ground allies too; clustered clan lines share incoming arc damage.

MNK.name: Monastic Orders
MNK.weakness: Low unit count and several one-copy holders; loses badly to attrition it cannot answer.

FUS.name: Fused Orders
FUS.identity: Two schools carried in one line
FUS.weakness: Expensive, few, and never a full platoon on their own; fusion units support an army, they are not one.

DIV.name: Divine Entities
DIV.identity: Summoned powers that answer a rite, not an order
DIV.weakness: Summon-only and one copy per battle; Anchors can be broken, and a staggered entity is a liability to whoever called it.
